sources.title: Max-Balancing Weighted Directed Graphs and Matrix Scaling
sources.implication: Classical potential reweighting, cut balancing, and cycle contraction. All-arc objective; direct selected-arc formulation appears in later sources.
sources.version_note: Received December21,1987; revisions March21 and October21,1989.

sources.title: Faster Parametric Shortest Path and Minimum-Balance Algorithms
sources.access: Full author-hosted version; arXiv cs/0205041v1 uploaded May18,2002
sources.implication: Selected-edge parametric shortest paths and faster classical minimum balancing; cycle potentials and contraction.

sources.title: Cycle Time and Slack Optimization for VLSI-Chips
sources.access: Full primary conference version at university archive
sources.implication: Only selected slacks are optimized, with structural inequalities retained; progressive cycle freezing and contraction.
sources.caution: Definition4.1 renders 'lexicographically minimal' in nondecreasing order, inconsistent with the described maximization. Screenshot retrieval failed. Later2003 full primary formulation explicitly says maximum.
